tmp.text: Eladamri is the Lord of Leaves, leader of the Skyshroud elves, whose wife dies in a fire that destroyed their home, likely perpetrated by Stronghold agents.
When the Oracle declares Gerrard the Korvecdal, Eladamri is convinced to aid the Weatherlight crew, and he releases Mirri and Hanna after Gerrard explains.
He leads a frontal assault on the Stronghold but cannot breach the Portcullis, and he later learns that his daughter Avila was murdered in her sleep by a Phyrexian agent who stole her body.

The Oracle declares him the true Korvecdal and warns that he must leave Rath; captured and tortured by Greven, he escapes and poisons Belbe with the same poison that killed Avila before fleeing to Dominaria.

sth.text: Eladamri rallies his people to charge, and elves and Vec soldiers charge up the mountain despite being outnumbered.
He says that Volrath shaped the Skyshroud troopers to war.
He later kills Belbe and flees to Dominaria, leaving Ertai to submit to Crovax.

nem.text: An assassin destroys what Eladamri loved most, his daughter, and Rath's rebels unite in his name to break free of Phyrexia's tyranny.
Crovax's assault on Eladamri's Skyshroud elves ends in a rout, and the Oracle en-Vec names Eladamri Korvecdal.
Captured, Eladamri attacks Belbe in rage on seeing his daughter's corpse reanimated, and she has him imprisoned and interrogated.
Belbe helps him and the last survivors escape to Dominaria, and Eladamri, seeing his dead daughter's face, kills her with poison.

pcy.text: Eladamri makes peace with Warlord Astor as Skyshroud overlays Keld.

Eladamri and Astor's armies make a stand against the Phyrexians at the Keldon Necropolis, and after the Golden Argosy arrives and rescues survivors, Eladamri and Sivvi sail on toward the battle at Urborg.

inv.text: Eladamri returns to help Gerrard against the Phyrexians, and Llanowar rallies around his banner.
Phyrexian airships bombard Llanowar with plague bombs, killing Takara and King Fhedusil, and Eladamri guides survivors to the Dreaming Caves, where the elves pledge loyalty to him.
At Koilos, after Thaddeus dies, Eladamri takes half the forces and with Agnate destroys the Phyrexian portal.
Freyalise takes Eladamri and his elves to Keld and tasks him to unite his people with the Keldons, though at the Keldon Necropolis the risen chieftains side with the Phyrexians.

pls.text: Eladamri's summons brings the tribes to lay aside their rivalries.
Freyalise shows him that his Skyshroud home has followed him to Dominaria.
